header.title: Backend developer with a soft spot for clean admin panels
header.subtitle: I like building the parts of a website most people never see — and making them easy for the people who manage them.

bio: I'm Abhisek Swain, a backend developer at Inflexi Technologies Private Limited. My day-to-day work is managing e-commerce websites: products, inventory, updates, edits and deletions, and keeping every piece of store data accurate across platforms like BigCommerce and WooCommerce.
Alongside store management I build custom CMS projects, giving clients their own dashboards to control content, bookings and listings without needing a developer for every change.

Outside work I keep shipping personal projects end to end — a photography site with bookings, a real estate portal with online payments, a temple website, a solar company site and a visitor management system. Each one is fully dynamic and CMS-driven.

points: Manage e-commerce websites end to end, including product catalogues and inventory.
Add, update, edit and delete products and keep all website data in sync.
Customize BigCommerce Stencil themes and WooCommerce / WordPress stores.
Design and build custom CMS projects for client websites.

approach.title: Data first
approach.text: I start with the data model — get that right and the pages almost build themselves.

approach.title: Built for the admin
approach.text: A CMS is only good if the client can use it without calling me.

approach.title: Reliable by default
approach.text: Validated inputs, clean routes and stores that don't break during a product update.
